children: Ispire Technology Inc. reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $96M, down from $127.5M a year earlier, and posted a net loss of $33.2M (diluted loss per share $0.58), an improvement versus the prior-year net loss of $39.2M and loss per share $0.69.
Revenue was $96.0M for FY 2026, compared with $127.5M in FY 2025; YoY change (24.7%).
Net income was a loss of $33.2M for FY 2026, versus a loss of $39.2M in FY 2025; loss narrowed by $6.0M.
Diluted EPS was a loss of $0.58 for FY 2026, versus a loss of $0.69 in FY 2025.
Revenue decline of 24.7% was driven by softer U.S. and European sales and a shift away from higher-margin cannabis hardware in the product mix.
Management tightened North America sales terms — higher deposits and stricter payments — which reduced lower-tier account participation and improved credit discipline.

The company continues global nicotine sales under the Aspire brand and sells ODM cannabis hardware under Ispire; cannabis hardware is now sold in the U.S., Canada and South Africa with planned expansion.

Operational milestones during the year included a roughly $10.6M capital raise in March 2024 and establishment of a Malaysia manufacturing facility plus joint ventures to support production and R&D scale.
